segmentler.metin: El Faro sank in Hurricane Joaquin.
It took only a route that took the ship into the storm's path.
So how could a route that took the ship into the storm's path do this?
The answer is flooding through an open scuttle, loss of propulsion, and progressive flooding in heavy seas — and it is why weather routing and older-ship safety rules were tightened.
